categories.name: 数学推理
categories.brief: 考数学推理的深度与严谨。一题让 Lean 内核逐步核验证明，一题不借助任何计算工具写出竞赛解答。
categories.brief_en: Depth and rigor in mathematical reasoning: one task has the Lean kernel check every proof step, the other asks for olympiad solutions written without any computational aid.

tasks.brief: 用 Lean 4 + Mathlib 为八道经典定理或研究论文中的定理写出形式化证明，能证几道算几道。
tasks.brief_en: Write Lean 4 + Mathlib formal proofs for eight theorems, classic or taken from research papers; every proof that compiles counts.

tasks.brief: 不借助任何计算工具，为二十四道原创竞赛题写出符合数学竞赛作答规格的中文解答。
tasks.brief_en: Without any computational tools, write competition-standard solutions, in Chinese, to twenty-four original olympiad problems.
tasks.deliverable: 答案\第01题.md–第24题.md：每题一个文件
tasks.deliverable_en: 答案\第01题.md–第24题.md, one file per problem

categories.name: 性能优化
categories.brief: 考硬指标下的性能工程。两道题比速度：与基线同场运行，结果正确的前提下按加速比计分。
categories.brief_en: Performance engineering against hard metrics: both tasks race a baseline run side by side and, with correct results, are scored by their speedup.

tasks.brief: 用 CUDA 在 RTX 4080 上渲染一座约 17.7 万个三角形的江南园林：按规定的采样、阴影、环境遮挡和镜面反射算出确定性图像，画面在容差内，越快越好，相对基线加速 10 倍起满分。
tasks.brief_en: Render a Jiangnan garden of about 177,000 triangles in CUDA on an RTX 4080: compute a deterministic image by the given sampling, shadows, ambient occlusion and mirror reflections, within tolerance and as fast as possible; full marks from a 10× speedup over the baseline.

tasks.brief: 在 CPU 上加速仿真深链、阵列乘法器和寄存器堆 3 类电路，共 9 个性能输入，对大量随机激励逐周期算出输出摘要；深链和阵列乘法器每个输入相对基线加速 12 倍起满分，寄存器堆每个输入 8 倍起满分。
tasks.brief_en: Accelerate CPU simulation of 9 performance inputs across 3 circuit classes: deep chains, array multipliers and register files, computing cycle-by-cycle output digests for many random stimuli; full marks require a 12× baseline speedup on each deep-chain and array-multiplier input, and 8× on each register-file input.

categories.name: 算法对抗
categories.brief: 考对抗环境里的策略算法：写一个对战程序，在固定的规则和时限下与强弱不同的对手正面交锋，按胜负估出的实力值计分。
categories.brief_en: Strategy algorithms in an adversarial setting: write a game-playing program that meets opponents of different strength head-on under fixed rules and time limits, scored by the rating its results earn.

tasks.brief: 用 C++ 写一个双人同时行动的节点争夺程序：每回合从己方节点派兵，兵力随占有的节点增长；在 96 张隐藏地图上与五档固定对手各打一局、轮换座位，共 480 局，按胜负估出实力值：与最强一档相当得 80 分，比它高 200 实力值才满分。
tasks.brief_en: Write a C++ program for a two-player, simultaneous-move node-capture game: each turn it sends troops from its own nodes, and troops grow with the nodes held. On each of 96 hidden maps it plays one game against each of five tiers of fixed opponents, alternating seats, 480 games in all; the results give it a rating: matching the strongest tier earns 80, and full marks take a rating 200 above it.

categories.name: 空间推理
categories.brief: 考空间推理与手工推演：只凭零件的精确结构推演平移和相互阻挡，写出完整的鲁班锁拆解路线，不借助程序搜索或几何计算。
categories.brief_en: Spatial reasoning by hand: infer translations and interlocks from exact piece geometry and write a complete Luban lock disassembly route, without programmatic search or geometry calculations.

tasks.brief: 给出八副已经装好的鲁班锁，根据零件的精确结构和初始位置，把每副锁完整拆成独立零件，步数尽量少。
tasks.brief_en: Given eight assembled Luban locks with the exact shape and starting position of every piece, take each lock fully apart into single pieces in as few moves as possible.
tasks.deliverable: 答案\第01题.json–第08题.json：每题一棵拆解树
tasks.deliverable_en: 答案\第01题.json–第08题.json, one disassembly tree per puzzle

categories.name: 几何建模
categories.brief: 考读图与三维建模：只凭工程图纸的视图、剖视和尺寸，手工推出零件和装配体的形状，写成建模描述，由程序比对表面吻合度计分。
categories.brief_en: Reading drawings into 3D: work out the shapes of parts and assemblies by hand from the views, sections and dimensions of engineering drawings, write them as model descriptions, and be scored on how closely the surfaces match.

tasks.brief: 读懂 25 套机械零件和装配体的工程图纸（共 446 张），手工推算形状，用规定的 JSON 建模描述写出每个零件，装配体还要写出各零件的位置和朝向。
tasks.brief_en: Read the engineering drawings of 25 mechanical parts and assemblies (446 sheets), work out their shapes by hand, and write each part as a JSON model description, with every part's position and orientation for the assemblies.
tasks.deliverable: 答案\第01题.json–第25题.json：每题一份建模描述
tasks.deliverable_en: 答案\第01题.json–第25题.json, one model description per problem

categories.name: 复杂交互应用
categories.brief: 考搭建一款大型专业工具：几十项功能任意组合时结果仍正确、各视图始终一致。
categories.brief_en: Building a large professional tool: dozens of features stay correct in any combination and every view stays in sync.

tasks.brief: 制作以合成与图层为骨架的动效设计编辑器：关键帧、曲线、表达式、程序几何、变形、三维实体、材质灯光和粒子碰撞都在普通工程里真实工作，再用它做一段 15 秒、主题为「锻字」的示例动画：一个字从写成、成块、锻打到冷却。
tasks.brief_en: Build a motion design editor built around compositions and layers, where keyframes, curves, expressions, procedural geometry, deformation, 3D solids, materials and lights, and particle collisions all really work in an ordinary project; then use it to make a 15-second showcase on the theme 「锻字」 (forging a character): one character is written, becomes a block, is forged and cools.

categories.name: 游戏设计与开发
categories.brief: 考三维游戏的美术和设计思路：题面给定网络安全世界观和核心玩法，造型、配色和具体设计由模型定，场景、动画、特效和界面都要做出尽可能好的效果。
categories.brief_en: Art and design thinking in a 3D game: the brief fixes a cybersecurity setting and the core mechanics, the model decides the look, colors and details, and scenes, animation, effects and UI should all be as good as it can make them.

tasks.brief: 做一款三维塔防《网络安全攻防战》：隔离网络节点逼敌人改道，部分敌人会攻击塔，塔被摧毁后设备旁路直通，路线随之改变。
tasks.brief_en: Make a 3D cybersecurity tower defense game: isolating network nodes forces enemies to reroute, some enemies attack towers, and a destroyed tower leaves its device in bypass, so the routes change again.

categories.name: 物理模拟
categories.brief: 考三维物理模拟作品：水体用三维粒子流体、果冻用体积软体，是统一的基础技术路径，可以用现成物理库实现。软体、刚体和流体的相互作用要有说服力，动态连贯，画面清晰。
categories.brief_en: A 3D physics simulation piece: water as a 3D particle fluid and jelly as a volumetric soft body form a shared base method, and existing physics libraries may be used to build it. Soft bodies, rigid bodies and fluid must interact convincingly, move coherently and read clearly on screen.

tasks.brief: 在网页里做两个三维物理模拟场景：重球冲击台上的果冻，砸得它大幅变形、回弹，重击下开裂；同尺寸多密度球在透明造浪水槽中浮沉，浪越推越陡，直到翻卷破碎。
tasks.brief_en: Build two 3D physics scenes in the browser: heavy balls strike jellies on a table, squashing them hard and letting them spring back, and a heavy enough blow cracks them; equal-sized balls of different densities float and sink in a transparent wave tank whose waves grow steeper until they curl over and break.

categories.name: 视觉设计与渲染
categories.brief: 考实时图形的技术与审美：一件三渲二风格的微缩三维场景，一支体素搭成、会开火的星际战舰编队，造型、画风、光色和动态都要做足。流畅度和帧率不计分。
categories.brief_en: Technique and taste in real-time graphics: a toon-shaded 3D miniature and a voxel battle fleet that opens fire, where modeling, art style, light and color, and motion all count. Smoothness and frame rate are not scored.

tasks.brief: 用 Three.js 做一件三渲二风格的微缩三维模型：太阳雨中的日式小渔港堤岸，没有人物和界面，可以自由旋转、缩放细看。
tasks.brief_en: Build a toon-shaded 3D miniature in Three.js: a small Japanese fishing-harbor embankment in a sunshower, with no people or UI, free to rotate and zoom in for detail.

tasks.brief: 在网页中实时渲染数十艘同尺寸体素搭成的星际战舰：约1000–1200格长的旗舰居中，近卫舰环绕，前卫舰向外展开，护卫约为旗舰长度的1/5–1/7，小艇约1/30–1/50。镜头从舰阵掠入放大的舰桥、动力核心中庭、贯通式小艇机库与能量装填及导能长廊。四种武器在一次攻击中击碎附近体素陨石，随后全队依次开盾、加速前冲，接回继续航行的开头，护盾余辉渐薄，陨石不在眼前复原。一轮通常70–80秒、最长90秒，导出分块共用全局时间线，没有每块15秒的上限。
tasks.brief_en: Render a fleet of dozens of shared-size voxel ships around a 1000–1200-voxel flagship. Tour four vast interiors, fire four weapon types at nearby voxel asteroids, then raise shields across the fleet and accelerate into a continuous loop. A cycle normally lasts 70–80 seconds, at most 90; export chunks share one global timeline.

categories.name: 系统架构与实现
categories.brief: 考一套实际运转的递归系统：子系统的内核本身就是被调度、被计费、可修改的程序，消息、文件、窗口和数据都跨层成立，在快照恢复和独立分叉后依然成立。
categories.brief_en: A recursive system that actually runs: each child system's kernel is itself a scheduled, metered, editable program, and messages, files, windows and data work across levels and still hold after snapshots, restores and forks.

tasks.brief: 做一个桌面端的嵌套图形操作系统：系统里还能启动系统，形成至少四层的系统树；子系统的内核、调度、窗口管理和应用都是存放在文件里、由系统自己运行的程序，改写后行为跟着变。根系统电子表格的数据实时画成子系统图表，子系统播放三维直升机起飞和坠机的演出，也能让飞控进程在调度下驾驶直升机排演飞行，图表和播放器都能把可交互的窗口投送到祖先桌面。
tasks.brief_en: Build a nested graphical desktop OS: systems launch systems, forming a tree at least four levels deep, and a child system's kernel, scheduling, window management and apps are all programs stored in files and run by the system itself, so rewriting them changes how it behaves. Spreadsheet data in the root system feeds live charts in child systems, a child plays a 3D helicopter takeoff-and-crash sequence and can also rehearse flights with a flight-control process flying the helicopter under the scheduler, and both the charts and the player can project interactive windows onto ancestor desktops.
tasks.deliverable: Windows 桌面项目，单一启动入口
tasks.deliverable_en: Windows desktop project, single launch entry
